== Summary ==
Original slip, 11 June 2003: Precision Targeting (V), as printed on the Players Committee's 11 June 2003 sheet for [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]].

'''Old pre-template slip''' (before the Committee's December 2006 Remaster template).

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf Virtual Set #5 revised sheet] (Players Committee, 11 June 2003; copy still hosted by the Players Committee at res.starwarsccg.org), page 3, slip 45. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip (with its printed label above it) cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Precision Targeting (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)]].
